{"parentUuid":"97014c22-42b8-47f3-abda-b3d9ee8a6de1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"703dedc7-b45f-423f-a67f-41e7ec19638e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0122hVTHKCMd4gXhbjPFBEfX","type":"tool_result","content":"------\ntitle:\tSpec: KCFC web CMS\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tiaishikb-rgb\nlabels:\tready-for-agent, spec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nThe Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) is run by three Presidents and about eight Officers, and nearly everything is communicated by email to financeclub@kenyon.edu. The current Wix site shows no officers, no meeting time and no events, its Contact Us link goes back to the homepage, and its Resources headings have nothing under them, so a first-year or an alumnus can reasonably conclude the club is dead. Only one or two people can update it, there is no way to give Officers limited access, and nothing stops an unfinished stock pitch from going out under the club's name in front of William Blair alumni. When leadership changes there is no clean way to hand over or take away access.\n\nVocabulary below is defined in `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## Users\n\n- **Presidents** (3, Admin role): run the club, review everything, sign off on what goes public.\n- **Officers** (about 8, Editor role): contribute meeting announcements, pitch writeups and alumni call recaps. Not technical; an announcement must take under two minutes.\n- **Visitors** (never log in): prospective members (first-years and sophomores) asking \"what is this, do I need experience, when and where do you meet\"; current members looking for event details, the resume review form and the Analyst Program; alumni and recruiters (including William Blair) checking leadership and activity before an event or pitch review.\n\n## Solution\n\nA small CMS with a local admin console on the Club laptop and a static public site. Presidents and Officers sign in with individual accounts. Officers write Posts and save Drafts; only Presidents publish, manage Pages, and manage Users. A Publish run turns everything Published into a static site on GitHub Pages. The first thing a Visitor sees is the next meeting. Nothing unreviewed reaches the public site, and an Officer who leaves loses access without anyone changing a shared password.\n\n## The 7 required capabilities, in KCFC's words\n\n1. **Login.** Presidents and Officers sign in and out with their Kenyon email and their own password. Passwords are stored hashed, never as text. A President sets the first password face to face, and resets lost passwords in person. Signed in on the shared Club laptop, a User is signed out after about 2 hours idle.\n2. **Two roles.** *Admin* (the three Presidents) can do everything. *Editor* (Officers) can write and edit only their own Posts, save them as Drafts and delete their own Drafts. An Editor cannot publish, cannot delete a Published Post, cannot touch any Page, and cannot see user management. These limits are enforced by the system itself, including when an Editor types a restricted address straight into the browser (the WordPress \"Editor can trash the About page\" problem from the field notes).\n3. **Posts.** One kind of Post (meeting announcement, pitch writeup, or alumni call recap), no categories. Each has a title, slug, Markdown body, Draft/Published status, author and timestamps, and can be created, read, updated and deleted under the role rules above. The slug is made from the title once and never changes when the title is edited; only an Admin can edit it. An Editor's edit to a Published Post turns it back into a Draft until a President republishes it. An Admin's edit leaves it Published.\n4. **Pages.** Lasting club information: Homepage, About, Leadership, Analyst Program, Join (for prospective members), Recruiting (for current members: resume review form link, standing guides). Same fields as a Post, but only Admins may create, edit, or delete them. Published Pages appear in the public Navigation in an order an Admin sets. The Homepage opens with the **next-meeting line** (plain text such as \"Next meeting: Wed Oct 28, 7 pm, Oden 110\", updated by a President the night before), then the contact email, then the latest Posts.\n5. **Admin console.** A dashboard with counts of Drafts, Published items and Pending changes (Admins also see active and Deactivated User counts), a one-click \"New Post\" button, and a \"pending changes\" banner so nobody assumes saved work is already Live. A content list, newest first, filterable by status (All / Published / Draft, with counts) and type; Editors see only their own Posts. An editor with a side-by-side Preview of the sanitized Markdown, labelled \"Draft, not Live\" when it is not.\n6. **User management (Admin only).** Presidents create Users, change Roles, and Deactivate Users. A Deactivated User cannot sign in, and an open session ends at their next action. Users are never deleted: when seniors graduate in May their old Posts keep their name but they cannot log in. A Deactivated User can be reactivated. At least one President must always stay active, and a President cannot deactivate themselves.\n7. **Public site and publish.** Visitors see only Published content. Markdown is sanitized (see below). Navigation is built from Published Pages plus a link to the Posts listing (newest first, title and date). Each Post shows a byline, \"By <name>, <date>\", never an email address; Pages show none. `cms publish` (Admin only, usually run right before a meeting) writes `site/` with relative paths only and deploys it to GitHub Pages. Marking an item Published has a \"Publish this?\" confirm. There is no change summary; a mistake is fixed by unpublishing and running it again.\n\n## User Stories\n\n1. As a first-year, I want the next meeting's date, time and place at the very top of the homepage, so that I know when and where to show up.\n2. As a prospective member, I want a Join page saying what the club does and whether I need experience, so that I can decide whether to come.\n3. As a prospective member, I want the contact email on the homepage, so that I can ask a question.\n4. As a current member, I want a Recruiting page with the resume review form link, so that I can request a review without digging through email.\n5. As a current member, I want a list of Posts, newest first, so that I can find the latest announcement.\n6. As a current member, I want to read about the Analyst Program on its own page, so that I know what it involves.\n7. As an alumnus, I want a Leadership page, so that I know who runs the club before I speak at an event.\n8. As a recruiter or William Blair alumnus, I want to read reviewed pitch writeups and recaps, so that I can see the club's work, and I want to see only reviewed work.\n9. As a Visitor, I want links that keep working, so that a shared link to a Post is never dead.\n10. As a Visitor, I want to see an author's name but never their email address, so that student contact details stay private.\n11. As a Visitor, I want the site to work when served from a GitHub Pages subfolder, so that no page or link is broken.\n12. As an Officer, I want my own account, so that I never share a password.\n13. As an Officer, I want to sign in with my Kenyon email, so that it is easy to remember.\n14. As an Officer, I want to write a meeting announcement in under two minutes, so that updating the site is not a chore.\n15. As an Officer, I want to write in plain Markdown with a preview beside it, so that I can see what the Post will look like.\n16. As an Officer, I want to save my work as a Draft, so that I can finish it later.\n17. As an Officer, I want my Draft to stay private until a President publishes it, so that nothing goes public by accident.\n18. As an Officer, I want to see and edit only my own Posts, so that I do not break another team's pitch before the William Blair presentation.\n19. As an Officer, I want to delete my own abandoned Drafts, so that my list stays clean.\n20. As an Officer, I want to be told clearly when I cannot do something, so that I do not think the site is broken.\n21. As an Officer, I want a \"Draft, not Live\" label on my preview, so that I do not think members can already see it.\n22. As an Officer, I want to be signed out automatically on the shared laptop, so that the next person cannot use my account.\n23. As an Officer, I want my name on my Post after I graduate, so that my work keeps its credit.\n24. As a President, I want to review every Draft in one list, so that I can sign off before publishing.\n25. As a President, I want to see all Drafts filtered by status with counts, so that I know what still needs attention.\n26. As a President, I want to edit any Post, so that I can fix a pitch writeup before it goes out.\n27. As a President, I want an Officer's edit to a Published Post to turn it back to Draft, so that no unreviewed change goes out.\n28. As a President, I want a \"Publish this?\" confirm, so that I do not publish by mis-click.\n29. As a President, I want to unpublish a Post or Page, so that I can take down a mistake and rerun the publish.\n30. As a President, I want to delete a Post or Page after an \"are you sure?\" step, so that deletion is deliberate.\n31. As a President, I want only Presidents to edit or delete Leadership and Analyst Program (and every other Page), so that Officers cannot damage official pages.\n32. As a President, I want to set the order of Pages in Navigation, so that the menu reads sensibly.\n33. As a President, I want to edit the Homepage's next-meeting line, so that the first thing a first-year sees is current.\n34. As a President, I want a banner showing pending changes, so that I know the live site is behind.\n35. As a President, I want to run `cms publish` right before a meeting, so that the public site is up to date.\n36. As a President, I want to create accounts and set the first password in person, so that no email system is required.\n37. As a President, I want to reset a lost password in person, so that Officers are never locked out.\n38. As a President, I want to change a User's role, so that a new President can be made Admin at turnover.\n39. As a President, I want to deactivate an outgoing Officer, so that they can no longer sign in.\n40. As a President, I want a deactivated User to lose access immediately, even if signed in, so that handover is clean.\n41. As a President, I want to reactivate a User, so that a returning Officer does not need a new account.\n42. As a President, I want the system to refuse to deactivate the last active President or myself, so that the club cannot lock itself out.\n43. As a President, I want an Editor who types an Admin address into the browser to be refused, so that restrictions are real and not just hidden menu items.\n44. As a President, I want dashboard counts, so that I can see the state of the site at a glance.\n45. As a President, I want Posts to keep their author when the user is Deactivated, so that the archive stays accurate.\n46. As a President, I want Markdown to be sanitized everywhere it renders, so that nobody can inject a script into the club's site.\n47. As a President, I want the database file never to be committed, so that accounts and Drafts stay private.\n48. As a President, I want to hand the whole system to next year's Presidents without a shared password, so that continuity does not depend on one person.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n- **Architecture** follows ADR-001 (admin console local, public site static, explicit publish) and ADR-002 (FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, argon2, no frontend framework). The dependency set in `pyproject.toml` is fixed; adding any dependency needs asking first.\n- **Roles:** exactly two, Admin and Editor. Permission checks live in one place on the server and every admin route goes through it, so direct URL access is refused as reliably as hidden menus. Editor-restricted requests return a refusal or redirect, never the page.\n- **Content model:** Post and Page share fields (title, slug, Markdown body, status Draft/Published, author, created and updated timestamps). A Post has no kind or category. Pages additionally have a navigation order. Status for a Page is Draft or Published like a Post.\n- **Slug rules:** generated from the title on first save, unique, immutable on title edit, editable only by an Admin, no redirects from old slugs. Navigation and the Posts listing use slugs, so links stay stable.\n- **Editing rules:** an Editor can read and change only Posts they authored; an Editor's save on a Published Post sets it to Draft. An Admin's save keeps its status. Marking Published is Admin-only and goes through a \"Publish this?\" confirm.\n- **Delete rules:** Admin can delete any Post or Page after a confirm step; an Editor can delete only their own Drafts. Unpublish (return to Draft) is separate from delete.\n- **Users:** email and argon2-hashed password; roles; active flag. Deactivating sets the flag; every request checks it, so an open session is refused at the next action. Users are never deleted. Guard rails: cannot deactivate or demote yourself, the last active Admin cannot be deactivated or demoted. First password is set by an Admin; no forced change at first sign-in; no email-based reset. Sessions are signed cookies with an idle timeout of about 2 hours.\n- **CSRF:** every state-changing form carries a CSRF token.\n- **Sanitizing:** every rendered body goes through the sanitizer, both in the admin Preview and in the exported site. Scripts, event handlers such as `onerror`, iframes and `javascript:` links are stripped. Plain formatting, headings, lists and normal links stay. Raw HTML embeds are not supported and images are out of scope.\n- **Publish:** the exporter renders only Published Posts and Pages into `site/` using relative paths only (never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`): Homepage (with the next-meeting line and latest Posts), each Page, the Posts listing, each Post with its byline, and Navigation built from Published Pages in Admin-set order plus the Posts listing. Drafts never leave the database. `site/` is generated, never hand-edited. Deployment pushes `site/` to the `gh-pages` branch. \"Pending changes\" is the difference between current Published content and what the last Publish run wrote.\n- **Console screens:** login/logout, dashboard (counts, New Post, pending changes banner), content list with status and type filters and counts, editor with side-by-side Preview, Page ordering, user management (Admin only).\n- **Seed and demo:** the existing seed script builds a demo database with one Admin and one Editor.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- A good test checks external behaviour only: what a signed-in role sees, can do, and is refused, and what ends up in the generated site. It does not assert on internal functions or database layout.\n- **Seam 1, the HTTP app,** through the existing `client` and `client_as(\"admin\" | \"editor\")` fixtures. This covers login and logout, role permissions (including direct URL access), Post/Page CRUD, slug immutability, Editor-edit-reverts-to-Draft, own-Drafts-only, deactivation, last-Admin and self-deactivation guards, CSRF rejection, idle timeout, dashboard counts, filters and preview.\n- **Seam 2, the site export,** through the existing render function (`render_site(out_dir)`). It covers only-Published content, Drafts absent, sanitizer behaviour (scripts, `onerror`, iframes, `javascript:` links stripped; headings, lists, links kept), navigation order, byline text with no email, and no root-absolute `href`/`src`.\n- No new seams are needed; these two already exist and are the highest available. The existing front-door tests must keep passing.\n- **Prior art:** `tests/test_t00.py` (client and `render_site` tests), `tests/conftest.py` (`client_as` fixture, written so access-control tests are one line).\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nExplicitly NOT building:","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"87e1d5de-efba-4d15-a34c-199752e8831b","timestamp":"2026-10-21T13:54:49.905Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"------\ntitle:\tSpec: KCFC web CMS\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tiaishikb-rgb\nlabels:\tready-for-agent, spec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nThe Kenyon College Finance Club (KCFC) is run by three Presidents and about eight Officers, and nearly everything is communicated by email to financeclub@kenyon.edu. Raw HTML embeds are not supported and images are out of scope.\n- **Publish:** the exporter renders only Published Posts and Pages into `site/` using relative paths only (never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`): Homepage (with the next-meeting line and latest Posts), each Page, the Posts listing, each Post with its byline, and Navigation built from Published Pages in Admin-set order plus the Posts listing. Drafts never leave the database. `site/` is generated, never hand-edited. Deployment pushes `site/` to the `gh-pages` branch. \"Pending changes\" is the difference between current Published content and what the last Publish run wrote.\n- **Console screens:** login/logout, dashboard (counts, New Post, pending changes banner), content list with status and type filters and counts, editor with side-by-side Preview, Page ordering, user management (Admin only).\n- **Seed and demo:** the existing seed script builds a demo database with one Admin and one Editor.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- A good test checks external behaviour only: what a signed-in role sees, can do, and is refused, and what ends up in the generated site. It does not assert on internal functions or database layout.\n- **Seam 1, the HTTP app,** through the existing `client` and `client_as(\"admin\" | \"editor\")` fixtures. This covers login and logout, role permissions (including direct URL access), Post/Page CRUD, slug immutability, Editor-edit-reverts-to-Draft, own-Drafts-only, deactivation, last-Admin and self-deactivation guards, CSRF rejection, idle timeout, dashboard counts, filters and preview.\n- **Seam 2, the site export,** through the existing render function (`render_site(out_dir)`). It covers only-Published content, Drafts absent, sanitizer behaviour (scripts, `onerror`, iframes, `javascript:` links stripped; headings, lists, links kept), navigation order, byline text with no email, and no root-absolute `href`/`src`.\n- No new seams are needed; these two already exist and are the highest available. The existing front-door tests must keep passing.\n- **Prior art:** `tests/test_t00.py` (client and `render_site` tests), `tests/conftest.py` (`client_as` fixture, written so access-control tests are one line).\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nExplicitly NOT building:","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"97014c22-42b8-47f3-abda-b3d9ee8a6de1","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"d24ba727-4e1a-4421-b903-ed1d7d17fd98","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d24ba727-4e1a-4421-b903-ed1d7d17fd98","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"mp2plus-categories"}

One short-lived connection per request.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    display_name  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at REAL NOT NULL,\n    updated_at REAL NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    nav_order  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at REAL NOT NULL,\n    updated_at REAL NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (\n    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    value TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef connect(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef init_db(path: Path) -> None:\n    conn = connect(path)\n    with conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        columns = {r[\"name\"] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(users)\")}\n        if \"display_name\" not in columns:  # database made before T07\n            conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\")\n    conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_db(request: Request) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"FastAPI dependency: a connection for this request, closed afterwards.\"\"\"\n    conn = connect(request.app.state.database)\n    try:\n        yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Posts: Markdown body, Draft/Published status, author, immutable slug.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nDRAFT = \"draft\"\nPUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    author_name: str\n    created_at: float\n    updated_at: float\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT p.*, u.email AS author_email, u.display_name AS author_name\nFROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(row[\"id\"], row[\"title\"], row[\"slug\"], row[\"body\"], row[\"status\"],\n                row[\"author_id\"], row[\"author_email\"], row[\"author_name\"], row[\"created_at\"], row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\n# \"index\" would collide with the generated index.html / posts/index.html.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    slug = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"post\"\n    return slug + \"-1\" if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS else slug\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    slug, n = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{base}-{n}\"\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n                now: float) -> int:\n    \"\"\"New Posts are always Drafts.\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, DRAFT, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n    return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef get_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> Post | None:\n    row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \" WHERE p.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_posts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None,\n               status: str | None = None) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first. author_id limits the list to one User's Posts, status to one status.\"\"\"\n    clauses, args = [], []\n    if author_id is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.author_id = ?\")\n        args.append(author_id)\n    if status is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.status = ?\")\n        args.append(status)\n    where = \" WHERE \" + \" AND \".join(clauses) if clauses else \"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + where + \" ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC\",\n                        args).fetchall()\n    return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n\n\ndef count_by_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Posts per status (draft, published), optionally for one author.\"\"\"\n    sql, args = \"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM posts\", ()\n    if author_id is not None:\n        sql, args = sql + \" WHERE author_id = ?\", (author_id,)\n    found = {r[\"status\"]: r[\"n\"] for r in conn.execute(sql + \" GROUP BY status\", args)}\n    return {DRAFT: found.get(DRAFT, 0), PUBLISHED: found.get(PUBLISHED, 0)}\n\n\ndef update_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                now: float, status: str, slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The slug changes only when a normalised `slug` is passed (Admin-only callers).\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" slug = COALESCE(?, slug) WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, status, now, slug, post_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef set_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, status: str, now: float) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (status, now, post_id))\n\n\ndef slug_taken(conn: sqlite3.Connection, slug: str, post_id: int) -> bool:\n    return conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                        (slug, post_id)).fetchone() is not None\n\n\ndef delete_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nRules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"../style.css\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nLayout: Pages are <slug>.html at the top, Posts are posts/<slug>.html, so a Post\nslug can never collide with a Page slug. \"index\" is a reserved slug.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, pages, posts, settings\nfrom app.markdown import render_markdown\n\nHOMEPAGE_SLUG = \"homepage\"  # the seeded Homepage; its slug is made once and survives renames\nLATEST_POSTS = 5\nANONYMOUS_BYLINE = \"Kenyon Finance Club\"  # a User with no display name; never an email\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-right: .75rem; }\nheader nav { display: inline; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _date(timestamp: float) -> str:\n    return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n\n\ndef _byline_name(post: posts.Post) -> str:\n    return post.author_name or ANONYMOUS_BYLINE\n\n\ndef _published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> tuple[list[pages.Page], list[posts.Post]]:\n    live_pages = sorted(pages.list_pages(conn, posts.PUBLISHED),\n                        key=lambda p: (p.nav_order, p.id))\n    return live_pages, posts.list_posts(conn, status=posts.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef _fingerprint(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A hash of everything a Publish run would write, to tell what changed since.\"\"\"\n    live_pages, live_posts = _published(conn)\n    content = {\n        \"pages\": [[p.slug, p.title, p.body, p.nav_order] for p in live_pages],\n        \"posts\": [[p.slug, p.title, p.body, _byline_name(p), _date(p.created_at)]\n                  for p in live_posts],\n    }\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(content, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef has_pending_changes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True when Published content differs from what the last Publish run wrote.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'last_publish'\").fetchone()\n    if row is None:  # never published: pending only if there is something to publish\n        live_pages, live_posts = _published(conn)\n        return bool(live_pages or live_posts)\n    return row[\"value\"] != _fingerprint(conn)\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = Path(out or settings.SITE)\n    database = Path(database or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    live_pages, live_posts = [], []\n    if database.exists():  # no database yet means nothing is Published\n        db.init_db(database)  # brings an older database up to the current schema\n        conn = db.connect(database)\n        try:\n            live_pages, live_posts = _published(conn)\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    def render(template: str, root: str, **context) -> str:\n        nav = [{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"{p.slug}.html\"} for p in live_pages\n               if p.slug != HOMEPAGE_SLUG]\n        nav.append({\"title\": \"Posts\", \"href\": \"posts/index.html\"})\n        return env.get_template(template).render(\n            root=root, nav=nav, site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n            contact_email=settings.CONTACT_EMAIL, **context)\n\n    homepage = next((p for p in live_pages if p.slug == HOMEPAGE_SLUG), None)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(render(\n        \"public/home.html\", \"\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        next_meeting_html=render_markdown(homepage.body) if homepage else \"\",\n        latest=[{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"posts/{p.slug}.html\", \"date\": _date(p.created_at)}\n                for p in live_posts[:LATEST_POSTS]]))\n    for page in live_pages:\n        if page.slug == HOMEPAGE_SLUG:\n            continue\n        (out / f\"{page.slug}.html\").write_text(render(\n            \"public/page.html\", \"\", title=page.title, body_html=render_markdown(page.body)))\n    (out / \"posts\" / \"index.html\").write_text(render(\n        \"public/posts.html\", \"../\", title=\"Posts\",\n        posts=[{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"{p.slug}.html\", \"date\": _date(p.created_at)}\n               for p in live_posts]))\n    for post in live_posts:\n        (out / \"posts\" / f\"{post.slug}.html\").write_text(render(\n            \"public/post.html\", \"../\", title=post.title, body_html=render_markdown(post.body),\n            byline_name=_byline_name(post), date=_date(post.created_at)))\n    return out\n\n\ndef publish(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"A Publish run: render site/ and record what was written, clearing Pending changes.\"\"\"\n    database = Path(database or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    # Fingerprint first: an edit made while rendering then shows up as Pending, never lost.\n    db.init_db(database)\n    conn = db.connect(database)\n    try:\n        fingerprint = _fingerprint(conn)\n        written = render_site(out, database)\n        with conn:\n            conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES ('last_publish', ?)\"\n                         \" ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value\",\n                         (fingerprint,))\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK if \"display_name\" not in columns:  # database made before T07\n            conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\")\n    conn.close()\n\n\ndef try:\n        yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Posts: Markdown body, Draft/Published status, author, immutable slug.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nDRAFT = \"draft\"\nPUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    author_name: str\n    created_at: float\n    updated_at: float\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT p.*, u.email AS author_email, u.display_name AS author_name\nFROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(row[\"id\"], row[\"title\"], row[\"slug\"], row[\"body\"], row[\"status\"],\n                row[\"author_id\"], row[\"author_email\"], row[\"author_name\"], row[\"created_at\"], row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\n# \"index\" would collide with the generated index.html / posts/index.html.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    slug = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"post\"\n    return slug + \"-1\" if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS else slug\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    slug, n = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{base}-{n}\"\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n                now: float) -> int:\n    \"\"\"New Posts are always Drafts.\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, DRAFT, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n    return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef get_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> Post | None:\n    row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \" WHERE p.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_posts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None,\n               status: str | None = None) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first. author_id limits the list to one User's Posts, status to one status.\"\"\"\n    clauses, args = [], []\n    if author_id is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.author_id = ?\")\n        args.append(author_id)\n    if status is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.status = ?\")\n        args.append(status)\n    where = \" WHERE \" + \" AND \".join(clauses) if clauses else \"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + where + \" ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC\",\n                        args).fetchall()\n    return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n\n\ndef count_by_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Posts per status (draft, published), optionally for one author.\"\"\"\n    sql, args = \"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM posts\", ()\n    if author_id is not None:\n        sql, args = sql + \" WHERE author_id = ?\", (author_id,)\n    found = {r[\"status\"]: r[\"n\"] for r in conn.execute(sql + \" GROUP BY status\", args)}\n    return {DRAFT: found.get(DRAFT, 0), PUBLISHED: found.get(PUBLISHED, 0)}\n\n\ndef update_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                now: float, status: str, slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The slug changes only when a normalised `slug` is passed (Admin-only callers).\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" slug = COALESCE(?, slug) WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, status, now, slug, post_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef set_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, status: str, now: float) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (status, now, post_id))\n\n\ndef slug_taken(conn: sqlite3.Connection, slug: str, post_id: int) -> bool:\n    return conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                        (slug, post_id)).fetchone() is not None\n\n\ndef delete_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nRules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Finance Club\"  # a User with no display name; never an email\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _published(conn)\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    def render(template: str, root: str, **context) -> str:\n        nav = [{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"{p.slug}.html\"} for p in live_pages\n               if p.slug != HOMEPAGE_SLUG]\n        nav.append({\"title\": \"Posts\", \"href\": \"posts/index.html\"})\n        return env.get_template(template).render(\n            root=root, nav=nav, site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n            contact_email=settings.CONTACT_EMAIL, **context)\n\n    homepage = next((p for p in live_pages if p.slug == HOMEPAGE_SLUG), None)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(render(\n        \"public/home.html\", \"\", title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        next_meeting_html=render_markdown(homepage.body) if homepage else \"\",\n        latest=[{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"posts/{p.slug}.html\", \"date\": _date(p.created_at)}\n                for p in live_posts[:LATEST_POSTS]]))\n    for page in live_pages:\n        if page.slug == HOMEPAGE_SLUG:\n            continue\n        (out / f\"{page.slug}.html\").write_text(render(\n            \"public/page.html\", \"\", title=page.title, body_html=render_markdown(page.body)))\n    (out / \"posts\" / \"index.html\").write_text(render(\n        \"public/posts.html\", \"../\", title=\"Posts\",\n        posts=[{\"title\": p.title, \"href\": f\"{p.slug}.html\", \"date\": _date(p.created_at)}\n               for p in live_posts]))\n    for post in live_posts:\n        (out / \"posts\" / f\"{post.slug}.html\").write_text(render(\n            \"public/post.html\", \"../\", title=post.title, body_html=render_markdown(post.body),\n            byline_name=_byline_name(post), date=_date(post.created_at)))\n    return out\n\n\ndef publish(out: Path | None = None, database: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"A Publish run: render site/ and record what was written, clearing Pending changes.\"\"\"\n    database = Path(database or settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    # Fingerprint first: an edit made while rendering then shows up as Pending, never lost.\n    db.init_db(database)\n    conn = db.connect(database)\n    try:\n        fingerprint = _fingerprint(conn)\n        written = render_site(out, database)\n        with conn:\n            conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES ('last_publish', extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts') }}\">All Posts</a></p>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <div style=\"display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;\">\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ '/admin/posts/' ~ post.id if post else '/admin/posts' }}\"\n          style=\"flex: 1 1 20rem;\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token() }}\">\n      {% if post %}<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"post_id\" value=\"{{ post.id }}\">{% endif %}\n      <p><label>Title<br>\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ form_title }}\" required style=\"width: 100%;\"></label></p>\n      {% if post %}\n      {% if user.role == 'admin' %}\n      <p><label>Slug<br>\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" style=\"width: 100%;\"></label></p>\n      {% else %}\n      <p>Slug: <code>{{ post.slug }}</code> (set when first saved)</p>\n      {% endif %}\n      <p>Status: {{ post.status | capitalize }}</p>\n      {% endif %}\n      <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br>\n        <textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"14\" style=\"width: 100%;\">{{ form_body }}</textarea></label></p>\n      <p>\n        <button type=\"submit\">Save Draft</button>\n        <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url('/admin/posts/preview') }}\">Preview</button>\n      </p>\n    </form>\n    <section style=\"flex: 1 1 20rem;\" aria-label=\"Preview\">\n      <h2>Preview</h2>\n      {% if not post or post.status == 'draft' %}\n      <p><strong>Draft, not Live</strong></p>\n      {% else %}\n      <p><strong>Published</strong> (Live after the next Publish run)</p>\n      {% endif %}\n      {{ preview_html | safe }}\n    </section>\n  </div>\n  {% if post %}\n  <p>\n    {% if user.role == 'admin' %}\n      {% if post.status == 'draft' %}<a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts/' ~ (post.id) ~ '/publish') }}\">Publish</a> ·\n      {% else %}<a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts/' ~ (post.id) ~ '/unpublish') }}\">Unpublish</a> ·{% endif %}\n    {% endif %}\n    {% if user.role == 'admin' or post.status == 'draft' %}\n    <a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts/' ~ (post.id) ~ '/delete') }}\">Delete this Post</a>\n    {% endif %}\n  </p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Content list</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts/new') }}\">New Post</a> ·{% if user.role == 'admin' %} <a href=\"{{ url('/admin/pages/new') }}\">New Page</a> ·{% endif %} <a href=\"{{ url('/admin') }}\">Dashboard</a></p>\n  <nav aria-label=\"Status\">\n    {% for key, label, n in status_links %}\n    <a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts?status=' ~ (key) ~ '&type=' ~ (type)) }}\">{{ label }} ({{ n }})</a>{% if not loop.last %} · {% endif %}\n    {% endfor %}\n  </nav>\n  <nav aria-label=\"Type\">\n    {% for key in type_links %}\n    <a href=\"{{ url('/admin/posts?status=' ~ (status) ~ '&type=' ~ (key)) }}\">{{ key | capitalize {"parentUuid":"3c4154ec-034a-407c-8fc2-eb80e2e60994","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"703dedc7-b45f-423f-a67f-41e7ec19638e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UZuQEZcoKBjZLqxaGuAYC9","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T02: Officers write and edit their own Post drafts. Seam 1: the HTTP app.\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of\n\n\ndef create_post(c, title=\"Meeting announcement\", body=\"Come to **Oden 110**.\"):\n    token = csrf_of(c, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    return c.post(\"/admin/posts\", data={\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef post_url(response) -> str:\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    return response.headers[\"location\"]\n\n\ndef test_officer_creates_a_draft_they_own(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(create_post(c))\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/posts/\\d+\", url)\n    page = c.get(url)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Meeting announcement\" in page.text\n    assert \"Draft\" in page.text\n    listing = c.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    assert \"Meeting announcement\" in listing\n    assert \"editor@example.test\" in listing\n\n\ndef test_slug_is_made_once_unique_and_survives_title_edits(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    first = post_url(create_post(c, title=\"Spring Stock Pitch!\"))\n    second = post_url(create_post(c, title=\"Spring Stock Pitch!\"))\n    assert \"spring-stock-pitch\" in c.get(first).text\n    assert \"spring-stock-pitch-2\" in c.get(second).text\n    token = csrf_of(c, first)\n    c.post(first, data={\"title\": \"Totally different\", \"body\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    edited = c.get(first).text\n    assert \"Totally different\" in edited\n\"\"\"T03: Presidents publish, unpublish and delete Posts. Seam 1: the HTTP app.\"\"\"\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of, sign_in\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import create_post, post_url\n\n\ndef president_for(editor) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A President on the same app and database as `editor`.\"\"\"\n    admin = TestClient(editor.app)\n    sign_in(admin, \"admin@example.test\", \"test-admin-pw\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef act(c, url, action, **extra):\n    token = csrf_of(c, url)\n    return c.post(f\"{url}/{action}\", data={\"csrf_token\": token, **extra},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef published_post(editor, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\"):\n    url = post_url(create_post(editor, title=title))\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    assert act(admin, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"Published\" in admin.get(url).text\n    return url, admin\n\n\ndef test_president_publishes_a_draft_after_a_confirm(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import publish\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        try:\n            settings.require_safe_secret_key()\n        except RuntimeError as problem:\n            print(problem)\n            return 1\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = publish()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n\"\"\"Tests for the context-threshold hooks (IPHS 400 MP2, setup exercise).\"\"\"\nimport importlib.util\nimport json\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nHOOKS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \".claude\" / \"hooks\"\n\n\ndef load(name):\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, HOOKS / f\"{name}.py\")\n    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)\n    return mod\n\n\nguard = load(\"ctx_guard\")\n\n\ndef run(script, payload, project, **env):\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, str(HOOKS / script)],\n        input=json.dumps(payload),\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\": str(project), **env},\n    )\n\ndomain.md\nissue-tracker.md\ntriage-labels.md\nhooks\nsettings.json\nskills\nstate\nuv 0.12.15 (Homebrew 2026-09-15 aarch64-apple-darwin)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"04ea5a04-d468-4dea-9ca2-45a4fd79b734","timestamp":"2026-10-21T13:55:16.146Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"T02: Officers write and edit their own Post drafts. {"parentUuid":"b7ec0bcd-00d4-4565-9478-d145c153b33c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgFVkn9UdrXV2QmsyNR3q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01L1R68MmFmUaPRAxVpYGHdH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_f2_categories.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F2: categories and tags. Seam 1 (HTTP app) and seam 2 (render_site).\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nfrom app.publish import has_pending_changes, publish, render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import post_url\nfrom tests.test_t03_president_control import act, president_for\n\n\ndef write_post(c, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"\", tags=\"\", body=\"Body text\", url=None):\n    \"\"\"Create (or, with `url`, edit) a Post with a category and tags.\"\"\"\n    path = url or \"/admin/posts/new\"\n    token = csrf_of(c, path)\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"category\": category, \"tags\": tags,\n            \"csrf_token\": token}\n    return c.post(url or \"/admin/posts\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef live(editor, admin, **fields):\n    url = post_url(write_post(editor, **fields))\n    assert act(admin, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return url\n\n\ndef render(client, tmp_path):\n    return render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", client.app.state.database)\n\n\n# Step 1: one category and comma-separated tags persist after save.\ndef test_category_and_tags_persist_after_save(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"NVDA, tech ,spring\"))\n    page = c.get(url).text\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"category\"[^>]*value=\"Pitches\"', page)\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"NVDA, tech, spring\"', page)\n\n\ndef test_category_and_tags_can_be_edited_and_cleared(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"a\"))\n    write_post(c, category=\"\", tags=\"\", url=url)\n    page = c.get(url).text\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"category\"[^>]*value=\"\"', page)\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"\"', page)\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_blank_and_repeated_tags_are_tidied(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, tags=\"NVDA, nvda,, ,tech,NVDA\"))\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"NVDA, tech\"', c.get(url).text)\n\n\n# Step 2: the admin content list filters by category.\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_category(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Pitch One\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Recap One\", category=\"Recaps\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Uncategorised One\")\n    everything = c.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in everything and \"Recap One\" in everything\n    filtered = c.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in filtered\n    assert \"Recap One\" not in filtered and \"Uncategorised One\" not in filtered\n\n\ndef test_category_filter_excludes_pages_for_a_president(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Pitch One\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    from tests.test_t05_pages import create_page\n    create_page(admin, \"About Page\", \"x\", \"1\")\n    assert \"About Page\" in admin.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    filtered = admin.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in filtered and \"About Page\" not in filtered\n\n\ndef test_editor_filter_still_shows_only_their_own_posts(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    write_post(admin, title=\"President Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Officer Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    listing = editor.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Officer Pitch\" in listing and \"President Pitch\" not in listing\n\n\n# Step 3: publish writes category/<slug>.html and tag/<slug>.html.\ndef test_publish_writes_category_and_tag_pages(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech, NVDA\")\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: XOM\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"energy\")\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Recap: Alumni call\", category=\"Recaps\", tags=\"tech\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    pitches = (out / \"category\" / \"pitches.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Pitch: NVDA\" in pitches and \"Pitch: XOM\" in pitches\n    assert \"Recap: Alumni call\" not in pitches\n    tech = (out / \"tag\" / \"tech.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Pitch: NVDA\" in tech and \"Recap: Alumni call\" in tech\n    assert \"Pitch: XOM\" not in tech\n    assert (out / \"category\" / \"recaps.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"tag\" / \"energy.html\").exists() and (out / \"tag\" / \"nvda.html\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_category_page_shows_the_name_title_and_date(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Stock Pitches\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"category\" / \"stock-pitches.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"<h1>Stock Pitches</h1>\" in html\n    assert re.search(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\", html)\n\n\ndef test_names_that_slugify_alike_share_one_page(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"One\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Two\", category=\"pitches\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"category\" / \"pitches.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"One\" in html and \"Two\" in html\n\n\ndef test_names_with_no_letters_or_digits_write_no_page(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Odd\", category=\"!!!\", tags=\"???\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"category\").exists() or not list((out / \"category\").iterdir())\n    assert not (out / \"tag\").exists() or not list((out / \"tag\").iterdir())\n\n\ndef test_markup_in_names_is_escaped(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Sneaky\", category=\"<script>alert(1)</script>\",\n         tags=\"<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    everything = \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n    assert \"<script>\" not in everything and \"<img src=x\" not in everything\n\n\n# Step 4: each published post links to its category and tag pages, relatively.\ndef test_post_links_to_its_category_and_tag_pages_relatively(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech, NVDA\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    html = (out / \"posts\" / \"pitch-nvda.html\").read_text()\n    for target in (\"category/pitches.html\", \"tag/tech.html\", \"tag/nvda.html\"):\n        assert f'href=\"../{target}\"' in html\n        assert (out / \"posts\" / \"..\" / target).exists()\n\n\ndef test_index_pages_link_back_with_relative_paths(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    for name in (\"category/pitches.html\", \"tag/tech.html\"):\n        html = (out / name).read_text()\n        assert 'href=\"../posts/pitch-nvda.html\"' in html\n        assert 'href=\"../style.css\"' in html\n        assert 'href=\"../index.html\"' in html\n\n\ndef test_no_root_absolute_paths_anywhere(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    for path in out.rglob(\"*.html\"):\n        assert not re.search(r'(?:href|src)=\"/', path.read_text()), path\n\n\ndef test_post_without_category_or_tags_has_no_taxonomy_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Plain\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert \"category/\" not in (out / \"posts\" / \"plain.html\").read_text()\n    assert not (out / \"category\").exists() or not list((out / \"category\").iterdir())\n\n\n# Step 5: drafts never reach either index page.\ndef test_draft_with_same_category_and_tag_is_absent(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Live Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Secret Draft\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    for name in (\"category/pitches.html\", \"tag/tech.html\"):\n        html = (out / name).read_text()\n        assert \"Live Pitch\" in html and \"Secret Draft\" not in html\n    everything = \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n    assert \"Secret Draft\" not in everything\n\n\ndef test_a_category_used_only_by_drafts_has_no_page(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Secret Draft\", category=\"Hidden\", tags=\"covert\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"category\" / \"hidden.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"tag\" / \"covert.html\").exists()\n    assert \"Hidden\" not in \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n\n\ndef test_unpublished_post_leaves_the_index_pages(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Soon Gone\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    act(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"category\" / \"pitches.html\").exists()\n\n\n# Publish run bookkeeping: a taxonomy change is a pending change.\ndef test_changing_a_category_is_a_pending_change(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    database = editor.app.state.database\n    publish(tmp_path / \"site\", database)\n    from app import db\n    conn = db.connect(database)\n    assert not has_pending_changes(conn)\n    write_post(admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Recaps\", url=url)\n    assert has_pending_changes(conn)\n    conn.close()\n\n\ndef test_an_editors_edit_keeps_taxonomy_and_returns_post_to_draft(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech, new\", url=url)\n    page = editor.get(url).text\n    assert \"Draft\" in page and 'value=\"tech, new\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_an_older_database_without_the_columns_is_upgraded(tmp_path):\n    import sqlite3\n    from app import db\n    path = tmp_path / \"old.db\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.executescript(\"\"\"\n        CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n            password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n            display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');\n        CREATE TABLE posts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n            body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n            author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL);\n        INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, role) VALUES (1, 'a@x.test', 'h', 'admin');\n        INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\n            VALUES ('Old', 'old', 1, 1, 1);\n    \"\"\")\n    conn.commit()\n    conn.close()\n    db.init_db(path)\n    conn = db.connect(path)\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT category, tags FROM posts\").fetchone()\n    assert (row[\"category\"], row[\"tags\"]) == (\"\", \"\")\n    conn.close()\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3154,"cache_read_input_tokens":76564,"output_tokens":5004,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":25},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3154,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":5004,"cache_read_input_tokens":76564,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3154,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3154},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01L1R68MmFmUaPRAxVpYGHdH":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_f2_categories.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus \"category\").iterdir())\n\n\n# Step 5: drafts never reach either index page.\ndef test_draft_with_same_category_and_tag_is_absent(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live(editor, admin, title=\"Live Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Secret Draft\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    for name in (\"category/pitches.html\", \"tag/tech.html\"):\n        html = (out / name).read_text()\n        assert \"Live Pitch\" in html and \"Secret Draft\" not in html\n    everything = \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n    assert \"Secret Draft\" not in everything\n\n\ndef test_a_category_used_only_by_drafts_has_no_page(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Secret Draft\", category=\"Hidden\", tags=\"covert\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"category\" / \"hidden.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"tag\" / \"covert.html\").exists()\n    assert \"Hidden\" not in \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n\n\ndef test_unpublished_post_leaves_the_index_pages(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Soon Gone\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    act(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"category\" / \"pitches.html\").exists()\n\n\n# Publish run bookkeeping: a taxonomy change is a pending change.\ndef test_changing_a_category_is_a_pending_change(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    database = editor.app.state.database\n    publish(tmp_path / \"site\", database)\n    from app import db\n    conn = db.connect(database)\n    assert not has_pending_changes(conn)\n    write_post(admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Recaps\", url=url)\n    assert has_pending_changes(conn)\n    conn.close()\n\n\ndef test_an_editors_edit_keeps_taxonomy_and_returns_post_to_draft(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"tech, new\", url=url)\n    page = editor.get(url).text\n    assert \"Draft\" in page and 'value=\"tech, new\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_an_older_database_without_the_columns_is_upgraded(tmp_path):\n    import sqlite3\n    from app import db\n    path = tmp_path / \"old.db\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.executescript(\"\"\"\n        CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n            password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, INTO users (id, email, password_hash, role) VALUES (1, 'a@x.test', 'h', 'admin');\n        INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\n            VALUES ('Old', 'old', 1, 1, 1);\n    \"\"\")\n    conn.commit()\n    conn.close()\n    db.init_db(path)\n    conn = db.connect(path)\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT category, tags FROM posts\").fetchone()\n    assert {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"d24ba727-4e1a-4421-b903-ed1d7d17fd98","hash":"eb563848aa406949ba38c17eb9b1c6bd96f2cb05aba6c8c129b1b060e6267da0","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"I'll write the tests first, one for each of the ticket's five steps, and then implement."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01L1R68MmFmUaPRAxVpYGHdH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_f2_categories.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F2: categories and tags. Seam 1 (HTTP app) and seam 2 (render_site).\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nfrom app.publish import has_pending_changes, publish, render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import post_url\nfrom tests.test_t03_president_control import act, president_for\n\n\ndef write_post(c, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", category=\"\", tags=\"\", body=\"Body text\", url=None):\n    \"\"\"Create (or, with `url`, edit) a Post with a category and tags.\"\"\"\n    path = url or \"/admin/posts/new\"\n    token = csrf_of(c, path)\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"category\": category, \"tags\": tags,\n            \"csrf_token\": token}\n    return c.post(url or \"/admin/posts\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef live(editor, admin, **fields):\n    url = post_url(write_post(editor, **fields))\n    assert act(admin, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return url\n\n\ndef render(client, tmp_path):\n    return render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", client.app.state.database)\n\n\n# Step 1: one category and comma-separated tags persist after save.\ndef test_category_and_tags_persist_after_save(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"NVDA, tech ,spring\"))\n    page = c.get(url).text\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"category\"[^>]*value=\"Pitches\"', page)\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"NVDA, tech, spring\"', page)\n\n\ndef test_category_and_tags_can_be_edited_and_cleared(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, category=\"Pitches\", tags=\"a\"))\n    write_post(c, category=\"\", tags=\"\", url=url)\n    page = c.get(url).text\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"category\"[^>]*value=\"\"', page)\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"\"', page)\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_blank_and_repeated_tags_are_tidied(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(write_post(c, tags=\"NVDA, nvda,, ,tech,NVDA\"))\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"tags\"[^>]*value=\"NVDA, tech\"', c.get(url).text)\n\n\n# Step 2: the admin content list filters by category.\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_category(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Pitch One\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Recap One\", category=\"Recaps\")\n    write_post(c, title=\"Uncategorised One\")\n    everything = c.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in everything and \"Recap One\" in everything\n    filtered = c.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in filtered\n    assert \"Recap One\" not in filtered and \"Uncategorised One\" not in filtered\n\n\ndef test_category_filter_excludes_pages_for_a_president(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Pitch One\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    from tests.test_t05_pages import create_page\n    create_page(admin, \"About Page\", \"x\", \"1\")\n    assert \"About Page\" in admin.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    filtered = admin.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Pitch One\" in filtered and \"About Page\" not in filtered\n\n\ndef test_editor_filter_still_shows_only_their_own_posts(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    write_post(admin, title=\"President Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    write_post(editor, title=\"Officer Pitch\", category=\"Pitches\")\n    listing = editor.get(\"/admin/posts?category=pitches\").text\n    assert \"Officer Pitch\" in listing and \"President Pitch\" not in listing\n\n\n# Step 3: publish writes category/<slug>.html and tag/<slug>.html.\ndef test_publish_writes_category_and_tag_pages(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"d24ba727-4e1a-4421-b903-ed1d7d17fd98","hash":"123416355c8fe90604bbd1f747e57f5d17bdd975be4a1b5e4ad22aa78dbfcd64","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01X9upzWyqi7cxD8e8RKsdDn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/taxonomy.py","content":"\"\"\"Categories and tags: how the two form fields are cleaned and turned into page names.\n\nA Post has one category (a single field) and tags (one comma-separated field). Names\nthat slugify alike (\"Pitches\", \"pitches\") are the same category or tag.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\n\ndef term_slug(name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"d24ba727-4e1a-4421-b903-ed1d7d17fd98","hash":"2ef648fb342949a21cf63fb2d41de929a6429a7740550dd6257f442412162e66","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_019DhDNjftsHApWUDs1t3WVg","content":"Launching skill: code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/.claude/skills/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nSearch the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\nIssue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted changes on branch mp2plus-categories (vs HEAD) against issue #11 (MP2plus F2: Categories and tags). Spec is issue #1; standards in CLAUDE.md and CONTEXT.md. Note: the spec's \"Out of Scope\" lists categories/tags, but ticket #11 is a later stretch goal that overrides it; CONTEXT.md was updated accordingly."}]}}
